mapper.insert: insert into "h_model_data" (username, age, total_month, visit_per_week, aver_exercise, pt_yn, group_yn, time_cong, last_days, contract_type) values (#{username}, #{age}, #{totalMonth}, #{visitPerWeek}, #{averExercise}, #{ptYn}, #{groupYn}, #{timeCong}, #{lastDays}, #{contractType})
mapper.select: select data_id, username, age, total_month, visit_per_week, aver_exercise, pt_yn, group_yn, time_cong, last_days, contract_type from "h_model_data" where username = #{username}
select data_id, username, age, total_month, visit_per_week, aver_exercise, pt_yn, group_yn, time_cong, last_days, contract_type from "h_model_data"
